workload.frames: u32 big-endian length followed by fixed binary pattern
workload.pattern: (index*17+index//251)%256; same independently checked frame per request

scope: Shared host with inherited CPU affinity, no exclusive isolation. Fixed successful protocol with per-request stdout/stderr bounds and30s deadlines in all adapters. Reported driver wall time includes worker launch,128sequential exchanges, byte oracles, explicit EOF, drain/reap and local cleanup. Driver startup/imports, fixed frame construction and compilation excluded. Outer wall and process-tree CPU include driver startup/imports and worker; they are auxiliary, not API-only CPU. Input socket vs pipes, poll/selector vs reader goroutines, allocation, signal/FD setup and exceptional cleanup differ. Not whole-API/safety parity, memory measurement, raw spawn cost, per-request latency distribution or a general language ranking.
